limitations: Live TEST pages are observed using managed test accounts; no production page or database is accessed.
Only login/logout and POST /api/v1/attendance/address are permitted. Business mutations, leave preview POSTs, file exports, camera capture and GPS capture are not invoked.
Roster editing is not exercised against live data; order stability and save behavior are covered separately by isolated component tests.
No physical phone, browser-specific native date picker, GPS accuracy or every permission combination is validated.
